scope: Complete byte and logical CSV row/field audit of five historical transaction archives; no runtime data adoption.

method.parser: Python standard-library zipfile plus strict csv; encoding verified over complete raw stream
method.numeric: Decimal precision 64; preserve printed zeros, signs and exponents; no binary-float arithmetic
method.row_locator: CSV logical record 1 is the header; record 2 is the first data row. Physical lines counted separately.
method.duplicate_method: SHA256 of JSON-serialized parsed string arrays; exact means decoded field equality, not raw CSV byte equality. Normalized rows trim strings, normalize valid m/d/Y dates, uppercase ISIN and canonicalize only RATE/QUANTITY/VALUE. Identifiers and categorical codes retain lexical zero padding. SHA256 collision possibility is not independently disproven.
method.candidate_key_method: Exact tuples of normalized identifier/date strings, compared with normalized nonordinal row fingerprints; no declaration that a candidate key is authoritative.
method.missing_policy: Raw empty/whitespace and listed marker lexemes counted separately; zeros remain real zeros.
method.rounding_diagnostics: For each decimal x, half printed unit = 0.5*10^exponent(x). Rate-only envelope = abs(QUANTITY)*half_unit_RATE + half_unit_VALUE, assuming quantity exact. All-operand envelope adds abs(RATE)*half_unit_QUANTITY + half_unit_RATE*half_unit_QUANTITY. These are conditional mathematical bounds if nearest rounding was used, not issuer-approved tolerances or pass/fail business validation.
method.code_policy: All observed low-cardinality code values and counts are retained. No inferred buy/sell, exchange, settlement, report, amendment or instrument codebook.

required_before_adoption: Validate the authoritative RFDE schema/codebook linkage and historical applicability before adopting transaction direction, instrument eligibility, report/amendment/cancellation semantics or settlement codes. This offline audit did not apply code meanings and does not assert that no external authoritative codebook exists.
Resolve repeated transaction keys and report revisions using an authoritative ordering and supersession policy; exact row duplicates are not the only double-counting risk.
Verify original publisher provenance, period completeness, publication timestamps/timezone and point-in-time availability; report dates are not proof of public availability.
Reconcile monthly exports for overlapping reports and transactions before concatenation; per-member key checks do not establish cross-archive uniqueness.
Do not treat masked FII, sub-account or broker values as stable identities across rows, files or time without a supplied crosswalk.
Map historical ISIN and instrument classes with corporate actions and contemporary eligibility; checksum and historical names do not prove current NSE_EQ membership.
Determine price/quantity/value units, rounding and special transaction semantics before aggregation; residual diagnostics do not independently prove source errors.

These records are historical transaction events, not OHLCV bars, current five-session signals, DII observations, positions/holdings, broker quotes or valuation inputs. No direct substitution into those consumers is justified.
Specify entity/symbol/daily aggregation population and direction only after codebook, revision, identity and availability contracts are resolved.
